title: 11 Days Yoga Retreat in Canggu Bali
metaTitle: 11 Days Yoga Retreat in Canggu Bali
metaDescription: Connect to nature , disconnect from technology as you refresh your entire being through a magical 11 days yoga retreat in Canggu Bali.
summary: A 11-day yoga retreat in Canggu including private accommodation, vegetarian meals, daily yoga, daily excursions and Ayurvedic massage treatments.
intro: Connect to nature, disconnect from technology as you refresh your entire being through a magical 11 days yoga retreat in Canggu Bali. Watching the sunset, admiring the nature, meditating, practicing asanas, exploring the beauty of Bali, trying out Balinese massage, trying out a healthy yogic diet, taking lessons on ayurvedic cooking, and making new yogi friends from a diverse yoga community are some of the must-try activities that comprise a true yogic holiday.

The course package does not ignore the basic amenities much needed during the 11 day stay, such as food, accommodation, yoga mats and so on, in order to make things easier and worthwhile for the participants.

inclusions: Yoga Mats and material for all activities
arrival: Participants must arrive on check-in time 12:00 pm afternoon on day 1st, retreat starts on day 1st at 4:00 pm with Ayurvedic massage treatment, Retreat completes on 11th day by 12:00 pm afternoon so Departure must be done after it.

The best and most convenient way to travel for Bali is to take a flight to Ngurah Rai International Airport. Ngurah Rai International Airport is merely 37 KMS from Bali yoga school; as soon as you book your flight, forward us your flight details and we will send our driver to receive you from the airport.
Note: Pick up charge is 30 USD extra from Denpasar Airport to school, make sure to inform the administration while booking the program.

policies.title: Booking Fees
items: In order to book for retreat, deposit an advance fee of 500 USD. This advance fee will be subtracted from the entire fee and the remainder of the yoga fee can be paid on arrival. An official booking confirmation letter will be sent to you shortly after successful advance deposit for the retreat fees.

policies.title: Refund Policy
items: An advance fee will not be refundable; only in the case of emergency students can join us on other schedules. If a student cancels the course after joining it, we accept cancellation but course fees will not be refunded in cancellation. There is no charge of course cancellation.
